Hi, I'm Fuguang Chen, a Master's student in Digital Economy at Monash University.

I am interested in data analysis, digital technologies, and how data can help us better understand real-world problems.

This blog was created for ETC5523: Communicating with Data. Here, I share data-driven stories, visualisations, and insights from my analysis.

Feel free to explore my work and visit my GitHub profile to see more of my projects.
